name: Design kit
description: Fonts, icons, styles, themes and chart and diagram rendering so bots can make artifacts that look designed. Everything is stored on this machine and works offline.
author: Crow
notes: The renderer turns Vega-Lite, Mermaid and D2 specs into SVG. It listens on 127.0.0.1:8018 only, and its rendering container has no route to the internet. Library files are copied into each artifact version when it is saved, never served from a shared path. v1: install it on the main Crow instance only; other instances on the same machine keep showing chart and diagram code as code.
